title: String — Where It Stands
thesis: Softanza's string is one Zig engine (utf8proc + PCRE2 + SheenBidi/HarfBuzz) behind a 2,212-method Haro face that is codepoint-correct end to end and reaches from core slicing through similarity, formatting and text analytics: a genuine superset of Python/Rust str. What it deliberately is not is ICU: no locale collation, no CLDR, no legacy charset transcoding.

lanes.note: Length, slice, index, insert, reverse all codepoint-correct via _EngineSlice/_EngineCount/str_mid_cp over utf8proc; guarded at multi-million codepoints
Full finder family over str_find_* / str_between_*; between/sections vocabulary is a superset of str libraries; returns all matches past 65,536 (guarded)
Codepoint-safe editing across replace.zig (70 KB): Replace[CS], ReplaceMany, positional, range and between edits; replaces Haro's byte-oriented substr
word_break.zig (UAX#29) drives Words, sentence and line splitting, streaming tokenizers and n-grams; split is one-pass linear (guarded)
Full NF-form normalization through utf8proc (str_normalize), mark stripping (RemoveDiacritics), space collapsing and Simplify
levenshtein, hamming, jaro, jarowinkler, jaccard, cosine, LCP/LCS, anagram, char-diff over codepoints in fuzzy.zig/compare.zig; a lane ICU does not enter
Unicode-default case via utf8proc plus detectScript/detectLanguage/detectDirection; Unicode-correct but not locale-correct (Turkish i, Greek sigma)
format.zig (75 KB): codepoint-width pad/justify/center, wrap, truncate, indent/dedent, mask, numberlines, boxing; box drawing emits ASCII not Unicode glyphs
Real PCRE2 under regex.zig (match/count/find-all/replace/split, Unicode) plus a W-conditional DSL (28 *W methods); deep regex story rated on its own page
VADER sentiment, NER, POS, lemma (en/fr/ar), stem, WordNet, TextRank/TF-IDF, summarize, readability, stopwords; dictionary-grade and English-centred
encode.zig covers url/html, base64, hex, RLE, CSV; md5/sha256/blake3/hmac; no legacy charset transcoding (Shift-JIS, GBK, ISO-8859-*, Windows-125x)
Locale is Haro-side tables (stzLocale, stzCountry, stzLanguage, stzScript); engine locale.zig is ten C-locale stubs; no collation, no CLDR; L0 not started

standouts: A genuine superset of Python/Rust str on breadth and Unicode-correctness
Between/sections finder vocabulary wider than any str library exposes
A similarity and distance lane that ICU does not even enter
Formatting and text-analytics lanes general str libraries do not have
gaps: Locale-aware collation + CLDR foundation (ICU's crown jewel)
Finish the narration audit: ~736 of 999 blocks unproven
Legacy charset transcoding (Shift-JIS, GBK, ISO-8859-*, Windows-125x)
